description: Ministry of Prison Reforms, Rehabilitation, Resettlement & Hindu Religious Affairs - Order under Part II of the Community Based correction Act, that the Judicial Division, of Galagedara shall come into operation w.e.f. 22.05.2017
reasoning: This gazette content is a legal/regulatory notice that brings specific provisions of the Community Based Correction Act, No. 46 of 1999 into operation for a judicial division. It contains a statutory instrument (ministerial order) made under an existing Act of Parliament, which falls under the definition of Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5) as it involves regulatory matters and the implementation of legislation. While it mentions a minister's name, this is incidental to the legal function being performed rather than constituting a personnel appointment or portfolio assignment.
